name: Creature corpse falls after dying during a parabolic knockback (#7345)
contract: #7345 reports a boar corpse left hard to reach after a knockback. The report's trigger spell is unknown;
existing spell 802600 is used only as a controlled native SPELL_EFFECT_KNOCK_BACK fixture.
A ground creature that dies during an active parabolic knockback must fall vertically to the valid
terrain or collision height beneath its corpse. Flying, hovering, underwater and ordinary ground deaths
keep their existing behavior. The discriminating observation is final corpse position_z against
ground_height, not knockback damage, displacement removal, loot contents or skinning data.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Ground-level Z before the controlled knockback
Start the native parabolic knockback without dealing damage
The boar rises above its starting height during the arc
The parabolic spline is still active before the killing blow
Kill the boar through the native death path in mid-arc
Ground height beneath the corpse at its death X/Y
The corpse begins the death fall above the ground
The corpse reaches ground height instead of remaining suspended
The landed corpse remains available for the native loot interaction
